comment:
* An autoCloseable iterator to iterate through a string proc file line by line. User must call
     * close() when finish using to prevent deadlock.

methods.name: public boolean hasNextLine()
methods.comment: @return Whether there are more lines in the iterator.

methods.name: public CharBuffer nextLine()
methods.comment:
* Fetches the next line. Note that all subsequent return values share the same char[]
         * under the hood.
         *
         * @return A {@link java.nio.CharBuffer} containing the next line without the new line
         * symbol.

methods.name: public int size()
methods.comment: Total size of the proc file in chars.

methods.name: public void close()
methods.comment: Must call close at the end to release the read lock! Or use try-with-resources.
